title: Israel Detonates Hezbollah Tunnel in Majdal Zoun as Lebanese Army Takes Pilot Zones
detail: On Oct 1 Israeli forces carried out a large detonation in Majdal Zoun, saying it destroyed a Hezbollah tunnel. NPR reported the Lebanese army has taken charge of pilot zones in the south after an Israeli pullout, but the U.S.-brokered plan for Lebanese forces to assume security there appears to be faltering.
